name: date-picker
useFor: Use for one date (survey date, site visit) or a range (permit window) in a form. Add presets for the common choices (Today, Next week).
constraints: Free text date entry without a picker
A picker for a time of day
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) for the field at the product scale, and the popover's panel
title: Date Picker
description: A 36px field with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line (Forest with focus) that opens a month grid in the popover's panel, with optional presets as square rows ending in Mireye's check.
